===========
Quick Start
===========

Get up and running in 5 minutes.

Installation
============

.. code-block:: bash

   pip install -r requirements.txt
   python main.py

Done! The application opens.


Loading Your First Data File
=============================

1. Click **File → Open FITS**
2. Select a FITS file
3. Choose the instrument (MUSE, ALMA, MIRI, NIRSpec)
4. Click **Open**

You'll see:
- **Intensity maps** (top center) - brightness at current wavelengths
- **Spectrum** (bottom center) - 1D spectrum of FITS file showing wavelengths and flux
